patched_projects.status: Latest published release v1.0.5 (2026-10-16 01:00 UTC) is a hotfix for a v1.0.4 startup crash affecting Linux/macOS, plus other fixes. The maintainer’s Oct 15 status still reports the entire teaser from first-boot options/preface through the ending, including the voice step; small lighting/material differences and timing details remain. The release updates the latest-version field and does not itself add a new completion milestone.
patched_projects.source_available: Public source repository; the project’s own port code is MIT-licensed. The 2026-10-16 v1.0.5 release publishes Windows and Linux setup programs, portable Windows/Linux archives, and macOS arm64/x64 archives and disk images. No game data is in the repository or installer; users supply their own PS4 dump or fake PKG.

patched_projects.status: Active development; the latest release tag KytyPS5-2026-10-16-3ff6606 was published 2026-10-16 UTC (2026-10-15 EDT). The README reports title-dependent boot/rendering results and identifies Windows/Linux as primary; macOS is experimental under Rosetta 2 on Apple silicon, with only a small set of in-game tests. This does not establish broad gameplay compatibility.
patched_projects.source_available: Public C++ source under GPL-2.0. The 2026-10-16 releases include Windows x64, Linux x86-64, and macOS x86-64 archives; macOS runs under Rosetta 2. The project does not distribute games or copyrighted system software and says to use only legally obtained game files.

patched_projects.status: WineMetalGL 3.2.0 remains the latest published release (2026-10-14). On 2026-10-16, merged PR #34 fixed GLSL line-continuation handling for shader compiler inputs. The maintainer reports that the 28 affected Godot shader variants compiled after the fix and that 61/61 host and 259/259 GPU tests passed. This is a targeted shader-compiler fix; the README’s documented game corpus and unsupported-feature list remain the compatibility references.
patched_projects.source_available: Public source under GNU LGPL 3.0; Wine and other build/runtime dependencies are separate.

patched_projects.status: The owner reports a playable native client on Windows, Linux and Apple Silicon macOS. The README reports all 281 differential parity harnesses passing on Linux and macOS, last audited 2026-10-13; this is parity for the compared harnesses. GitHub lists v2026.10.16.03 (published 2026-10-16 05:11 UTC, commit f188dfe) as the latest release; its notes cover chat camera input and trial chamber, vault, and trial spawner fixes. The README still labels v2026.10.13.1 as the latest release, so its release-summary section is stale. The new release notes also mention a sprint-jumping report the maintainers could not reproduce.
